title: quest_markers
summary: MSUI proactively queries every visible questgiver, re-asks on the complete self descriptor watch (level, alive/dead edge, player flags, money, quest log, all 128 skill IDs/current ranks, and 23 inventory/equipped-bag slots), the packet epoch (faction standing, group roster, quest completion and quest-update families), or giver service/faction changes, and prunes stale answers. Friendly flight masters are queried on refresh and mouseover. The render path loads the authored grey/light-blue/gold/green TalkToMe M2s, attaches them to the current posed body at exact slot 18 or mounted slot 29, latches the one-time 1/L joint counter-scale, and plays/re-arms low animation 0 or raised animation 190 through the shared skinned/billboard world-mesh renderer. Focused laws, source wiring, build and real-MPQ asset probes pass; authenticated live visual/status verification remains.

openItems.text: No overhead markers are rendered at all: the status->model dispatch (grey/gold !/?, light-blue ?, attachment-18 seat, 1/L counter-scale, low/raised bob anims) has no counterpart - questgivers show nothing above their heads
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: QuestMarkerUiLaw maps statuses 1/3/4/5/6/7 and GameLoop.QuestMarkers draws their grey/light-blue/gold !/? states at the overhead seat with bob/raise. Exact TalkToMe M2 geometry remains a new explicit gap.

openItems.text: No proactive status querying: visible UNIT_NPC_FLAG_QUESTGIVER creatures are never swept on create, and none of the re-ask law (self descriptor watch / packet-epoch sweep, per-unit flag/reaction re-ask, teardown when the questgiver bit drops) exists - status is only fetched on direct interaction or dev command
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: visible questgivers are asked on first sight, re-asked for player quest/economy/equipment generation changes and per-unit NPC-flag/faction changes, and pruned on despawn or questgiver-bit teardown. Remaining skill/player-flags/packet-epoch inputs stay open below.

2026-08-21: Visible friendly flight masters now receive CMSG_TAXINODE_STATUS_QUERY on refresh and mouseover; SMSG_TAXINODE_STATUS is cached and unknown nodes feed the shared green TalkToMe overhead state.

openItems.text: Replace the projected !/? compatibility renderer with the exact TalkToMe M2 skinned/billboard geometry, attachment-18/29 seating and one-time 1/L counter-scale.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: QuestMarkerModelSource feeds the actual TalkToMe M2s into SpellEffectMeshRenderer using the unit's current posed attachment 18/29, exact no-anchor invisibility, per-seat 1/L counter-scale latch, and edge-rearmed animation 0/190. The old projected ImGui glyph renderer was removed. QuestMarkerClinicalChecks validates the pure laws, runtime wiring and all six real MPQ assets (valid one-bone mesh, 0/190 bands, plain-vs-billboard classification).

openItems.text: Quest-status sweep still needs the remaining Benilla refresh inputs: all skill ranks and the packet re-ask epoch for reputation/group/quest packet transitions.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: QuestStatusRefreshLaw folds all 128 PLAYER_SKILL_INFO id/current-rank pairs into the descriptor generation and advances a wrapping packet epoch after successfully parsed faction-standing, group-list, quest-complete and QUESTUPDATE add-kill/add-item/complete/failed/failed-timer packets. Focused checks cover the final skill slot, current-vs-max/bonus semantics, epoch invalidation and exact opcode membership.

openItems.text: Build, source, pure-law and real-MPQ model probes pass. Needs an authenticated live walk covering grey/gold/light-blue quest states, green unknown-flight-master state, constant marker size across differently scaled NPCs, nameplate low/raised animation edges, a mounted slot-29 giver if available, and status re-asks after skill, reputation, group and quest-update transitions.
